finding: Exterior reserve guards intentionally do not belong to the interior CLEAR participant roster. BuildingOperationStep calls shared motion recording/CHECK for their issued moves and settled WAIT arrival, but BuildingActorMotion refused nonparticipants unconditionally. A guard could move successfully yet lack the receipt needed by subsequent arrival/security logic.
implementation: BuildingActorMotion resolves the supplied/retained leg first. Outside the assault roster it requires the exact current reserve generation/owner epoch/post marker. MOVE matches that post exactly; HOLD remains within2m/0.75m vertically. All current CLEAR operation, visit nonce, route, actual native command/endpoint/rest, actor ownership/eligibility and live-producer checks remain. No arbitrary group membership permission.

Exterior APPROACH observes delayed actual native MOVE acknowledgement through the existing loop. It writes a missing/mismatched current group/visit/leg receipt only while that exact own MOVE is current. It never calls the movement-issue helper, so request/search/progress/deadline clocks are not renewed.
Journal records/adopts metadata only. No movement command, interior team expansion, new worker, world query, direction search, new setting or physical clearance credit.
cost: One local role receipt check per shared motion validation; constant-size vector tests for matching exterior holds. Existing exterior loop adds a current-receipt comparison while an owned APPROACH is MOVE; full recording is skipped once matching metadata exists. No additional scan or scheduler.

validation.intermediateFailure: Build2 failed a newly extended existing test because its no-reissue pattern matched an explanatory comment. The assertion now checks the actual call syntax; movement replay/deadline bans remain.

limitations: A pending request is not acknowledgement; this does not manufacture a receipt for already-settled work that never had a recorded MOVE.
Coherent producer checkpoint/replay, absent/delayed journal distinctions, full exterior aggregate adoption/readiness and actual old-owner/controller quiescence remain incomplete.
